acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.description: Spent years in service at a temple, acting as an intermediary between mortal life and the divine.

criminal.name: Criminal
criminal.description: A seasoned lawbreaker with a history of illicit dealings and underworld contacts.

folk_hero.name: Folk Hero
folk_hero.description: A champion of the common people whose courage stands against oppression and danger.

noble.name: Noble
noble.description: Born into wealth and privilege, accustomed to influence, high societal expectations, and power.

sage.name: Sage
sage.description: A dedicated scholar who spent years gathering lore, research, and ancient knowledge.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: Trained in tactical warfare, disciplined combat tactics, and military life on the battlefield.

urchin.name: Urchin
urchin.description: Grew up poor and homeless, relying on quick wits and street instincts to survive.

outlander.name: Outlander
outlander.description: Raised in the wild far from civilization, expert in survival, tracking, and nature.
